{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of unique patients after deduplication
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_patients}')

# Now handle the assay_batch unit issue: batch B reports in µg/L, but we need ng/mL
# 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, so divide batch B values by 10
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
# Apply correction only to assay_batch == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final_corrected
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (corrected to ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}')"}
